The main takeaway from our work is that
amino acid pair frequency based prediction of b transmembrane regions can be improved significantly by incorporating position specific amino acid preference information.
a simple amino acid pair frequency based predictor can be as accurate as other sophisticated predictors that incorporate multiple sequence alignments and/or evolutionary information.
a sequence pattern based predictor is able to provide better prediction results than the predictors based on sequence profiles.
